title: Link VoxelDocument into the look-dev capture target automatically
body: The per-recipe look-dev path needs PackRecipeSource and EditorDocumentModel, but application/main/tests/test_lookdev_capture.cmake did not link VoxelDocument. I had to add a manual target_link_libraries entry so the facade's pack recipe source is available to the capture executable; make this dependency part of the reusable capture target or generated consumer wiring.

title: Carry authored GlyphOutline rows through pack recipe preview
body: PackRecipeSource resolves a recipe document path but the VRC1 asset carries no GlyphOutline rows, so I had to manually open the bundled Lato face and rebuild rows in application/main/tests/test_lookdev_capture.cpp before registration. The facade should transport or deterministically resolve authored glyph rows from the render_recipe asset instead of requiring a capture-side font workaround.

title: Forward per-recipe look-dev inputs through the native launcher
body: Native capture requires VIXEN_LOOKDEV_RECIPE_PATH/pack/id/params/scale and VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_DIR, but tools/vixen-native.sh only forwarded general build knobs. I added a WSLENV forwarding list with path conversion for the recipe/pack/schema/output paths and scalar conversion for ids/params; the launcher should expose a declarative capture-input contract instead of each visual lane editing its forward list.

title: Define the authored string-to-runtime recipe id contract
body: PackRecipeSource exposes ids such as undercard:card-template, while InvokeRecipe bytecode carries a uint32 recipe id. The existing facade has no mapping contract, so the preview path had to invent a local FNV-1a mapping to resolve nested callees. Consolidate this in the recipe emitter/pack manifest and make capture/runtime consume the same generated mapping; otherwise nested authored card recipes cannot be verified safely.

title: Make native configure inherit the required provider roots
body: The queued native baseline command without provider roots failed at libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent. Re-running with UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow and YEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy recovered configure. The native launcher/build contract should resolve or require these provider roots before CMake rather than failing deep in a consumer library.
